note: vespera-bridge (WebFlux): an implicitly streamed GET (no Accept or a wildcard Accept, as curl and fetch() send) whose Rust Content-Type is an event-stream / NDJSON stream now holds its first body bytes like an explicit stream (until the Rust body would wait, more than 64 KiB, or the end of the body), so a panic or body error before the first flush hint is answered with the proxy 500 instead of aborting a committed 200; the error shape no longer depends on the client's Accept. Test fix: HeaderPolicyTest counts every getHeaderNames() call, so its one-enumeration assertion can fail.
